hypothesis: A batch-level accepted-liquid contract that includes upstream mass, upgrading, capital recovery and separately allocated R&D lock-up interest exposes bottlenecks hidden by crude bio-oil yield alone.

interface.evidence_rule: output always MODEL_ONLY; input labels never promote evidence automatically

literature.source: Dimitriadis, Tuler and Bezergianni, ACS Omega

open_gaps: No catalyst lifetime, hydrogen or utility-energy dataset
No verified coproduct market or commercial financing terms
falsifier: Reject accepted-fuel cost claims if product fails frozen acceptance, mass balance misses tolerance, upgrading inputs are omitted, required costs are unknown, or coproduct streams overlap.
next_gate: Run provenance-pinned independent Pangola batch trials; keep FUS-001 net-electric costs and FIN-001 principal/rate effects separate.
